description:
I spent 30+ years on the line as a firefighter — pulling families out of houses that could've been saved with a $10 fix, and watching careful, sensible people get caught off guard by mistakes nobody ever warned them about.

This channel is everything I wish every homeowner knew before the trucks show up: the habits that actually keep a house safe, the "safety" gadgets that don't do what the box promises, and the cheap, ten-second fixes that matter more than any alarm system ever will.
